crossRefs.note: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

parallels.note: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

translations.web: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
translations.bsb: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
translations.kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
translations.asv: And when it was evening he cometh with the twelve.
